directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 20 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Output Capacity 8–10 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 10 MPa. Output is a volume rate. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_(unit).
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动20型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成8–10 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成10 MPa。电动20型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成8–10 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成10 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_(unit)。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_(unit). The picture shows Aluminium cylinder. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 20 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Output Capacity 8–10 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 10 MPa. On the Electric 20 Concrete Pump sheet, Output Capacity is 8–10 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 10 MPa. Maximum aggregate size is 1–2 cm. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row. Maximum aggregate size is 1–2 cm.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_(unit)。画面是Aluminium cylinder。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动20型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成8–10 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成10 MPa。行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

body.en: Output is a volume rate. A number in m³/h is a volume rate, and a number in MPa is pressure. Delivery Pipe Diameter 80 mm. The Xingtai row does not list a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Delivery Pipe Diameter 80 mm.
body.zh: 电动20型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成8–10 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成10 MPa。邢台这一行没有标出保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。

body.en: Pressure is a separate entry on the same sheet. Hopper capacity is 0.25 m³. Its subject is Force pump. Hopper capacity is 0.25 m³. Those shown extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成电动20型混凝土泵的铭牌。

question.en: What output does the Electric 20 Concrete Pump sheet list?
question.zh: 电动20型混凝土泵这一页的输送量标出多少？

answer.en: Output Capacity is 8–10 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_(unit).
answer.zh: 理论输送量是8–10 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_(unit)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: What pressure entry is on the same sheet?
question.zh: 同一页的压力格是多少？

answer.en: Max. Outlet Pressure is 10 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_(unit).
answer.zh: 最大出口压力是10 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_(unit)画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. The sheet leaves stroke length, cycle rate and price unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_(unit).
answer.zh: 没有。这一页没有标出行程、冲次和价格。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_(unit)画面里印出的数字。
